facts.why: The market's road code reaches the kit route. The route read 548,216 B gzip against a limit of 548,215 B, 1 B over. This branch adds 1,304 B gzip on top of main at fcc2b457, which reads 546,912 B. The row's headroom had gone on earlier work since its October 31 baseline.

The graphics_lost player event, its loss tracker and the screen-to-place table reach the worker bundle. The worker read 747,863 B raw and 192,652 B gzip in CI on 0a188e35, against limits of 747,381 B and 192,301 B. Main at b06f24dc reads 745,776 B and 192,127 B, so this branch adds 2,087 B raw and 525 B gzip. The rows' headroom had gone on earlier work since their November 4 baseline. A and B differ by 108 B raw and 16 B gzip, all in the TanStack start manifest's build names.

Signal lost and Your bike is up move from a lazy chunk into the root route, because a rider whose network drops cannot download the screen that tells them so. Main at 22e4cdab read 1,167,867 B raw in CI against a limit of 1,169,266 B, and this branch reads 1,170,534 B on this Mac, about 2.7 KB more. The gzip row stays under its limit. A and B read the same.

facts.attempts: three runs of the perf job on Node 26.13.0. Attempt 1 landed on an AMD EPYC 9V45 and attempt 2 on an Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C; their allocation rows matched this run within 5%, and their calibrated timings did not. This run landed on an AMD EPYC 7763, the model the budget rows are set on, so every re-pinned row comes from it. The node-linux-x64 profile is kept: this run scaled by 1.017 against its c0.
facts.why: The perf job moved from Node 24.22.1 (V8 13.6) to Node 26.13.0 (V8 14.6). The allocation rows moved to 0.12 to 0.89 of their baselines, and the sim, room, road-life and lobby timing rows to 0.69 to 0.88, or 1.17 to 1.20 for throughput. The snapshot rows moved about 2% (at most 2.2%) and keep their baselines. Node 24 on this Mac reproduced CI's old allocation numbers within 2%, so the change is V8's, not the runner's.

The first download stops counting font files a browser never fetches: the .woff fallback behind each woff2, the non-Latin subsets, and Geist Mono, which nothing renders. The Madrid stretches leave the bundle once @racer/track declares its import side effects. Against main at 36883781 the root route and the game fall by about 236 KB gzip, the kit route by about 228 KB, the client by about 79 KB and the Worker by about 9 KB, so those rows re-pin on this run and the root row takes a new owner cap, 2% over 385,548 B, rounded up.

The room client glides corrections with the speed they carry, eases the race's pace, holds hits a replay finds until it is drawn and records what each drawn frame cost, so the game chunk loaded after the menus grows by about 1.4 KB gzip against 7fec2e9's run and the two bytes.game.incremental rows re-pin on this run.
